coder_notes: Dose-escalation cohorts of one drug; the four registered intervention entries are collapsed into one agent row. PK is plasma only (Cmax, Tmax, AUC, t1/2). Eligibility refers to histology 'or molecular studies' without naming a specific biomarker, so none coded. No IDH requirement and grade 3/4 astrocytoma and oligodendroglioma allowed, so historical terminology.
